description: Implementation of time-related functions for high-resolution timing, including getting current time, calculating elapsed time, comparing times, and converting to string or timespec.

methods.name: rtTime_Now
methods.description: Retrieves the current time using CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculates a future time by adding milliseconds to a start time.

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed milliseconds between two times.

methods.name: rtTime_Compare
methods.description: Compares two rtTime_t instances, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Converts an rtTime_t to a human-readable string.
